tools.name: llm_leaderboard
tools.description: Which LLMs are up, correct and fast right now. Every 15 minutes ~20 popular models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Qwen, Cohere...) are asked to reply 'pong'; returns rank, score (60% 24h correctness + 40% speed), correct %, p50 time-to-first-token, p50 total time, cost per

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Before calling an external API, ask which provider to use. Give a task phrase or category (e.g. 'send email', 'web search', 'llm', 'scrape a page', 'vector db', 'speech to text', 'payments', 'geocode'). Returns the top healthy pick plus 1-2 fallbacks ranked by live status, vendor status, 7-day uptim

tools.name: incidents
tools.description: Outages (consecutive failed probes) and vendor status-page incidents with UTC start/end over the last N days (max 7). Optional provider name filter. Use to judge whether a failing API is a known incident.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the APIs and MCP servers Agent Daily monitors, with current up/down, latency and vendor status. Call before choosing a provider. Optional category filter (e.g. LLM, MCP, Search, Payments, Comms, Infra).

tools.name: tool_status
tools.description: Full status record for one monitored tool (up, http_status, latency_ms, vendor_status, uptime_24h_pct). Case-insensitive name or substring, e.g. 'openai', 'GitHub MCP'. Reachability only, not correctness.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "recommend" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Before calling an external API, ask which provider to use. Give a task phrase or category (e.g. 'send email', 'web search', 'llm', 'scrape a page', 'vector db',…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recommend · Private data: llm_leaderboard, recommend, tool_status · Public sink: recommend.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recommend · Private data: llm_leaderboard, recommend, tool_status · Public sink: recommend

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
